author: liluocheng13
text:
Somewhere between autumn and eternity, time seems to stand still. 🍁

Crimson maple leaves drift across a silent lake. Mount Fuji watches from beyond the clouds, while a lone swordswoman walks through a world that feels like a half-forgotten dream.

I’ve always loved this kind of beauty — quiet, melancholic, and a little unreal.

Sometimes, the most beautiful stories are the ones that need no words.

A little piece of my imagination, brought to life through AI. 🎬
